entry.title: A simple twist to altermagnetism
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03495-x Two-dimensional altermagnets hold promise for next-generation spintronics but remain difficult to synthesize. Now, altermagnetism has been observed in an orthogonally twisted van der Waals homostructure, opening possibilities for ultrathin devices.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Curvature and cell mechanics control tissue organization
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03496-w Tissue geometry mechanically regulates cell behaviour across scales. Now, it can be predicted when cells switch from full adhesion to rapid partial detachment on curved surfaces.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics
